title: Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece
description:
The Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece is essential for your U6, designed to provide a smooth and clean vapor experience. Made from heat-resistant glass, it connects directly to the vaporizer and allows vapor to travel from the heating chamber to your mouth. The glass material ensures that no unwanted flavors are imparted to the vapor, preserving the natural taste of your concentrates. It is easy to detach and clean, ensuring that it remains free of residue and buildup, which helps maintain the quality of each session.

Unleash True Flavor

The Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece is more than just a necessary accessory. It’s crafted from high-quality borosilicate glass to provide pure-tasting vapor. Your concentrate’s flavors will shine through without any unwanted interference.
Seamless Integration, Optimal Performance

Engineered with precision, the Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece seamlessly integrates with your Utillian 6 Wax Pen. The included vortex seal ensures a secure fit and prevents any unwanted airflow. Its airtight seal maximizes vapor production and delivers a smooth, consistent draw every time.
Effortless Maintenance

Keeping your mouthpiece clean is essential for preserving flavor and extending its lifespan. The Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece is incredibly easy to clean. Simply detach it from your device and soak it in isopropyl alcohol to dissolve any residue. Rinse with water and dry thoroughly for a sparkling-clean mouthpiece ready for your next session.

Compatibility:
Utillian 6

Package contents:
1x Utillian 6 Glass Mouthpiece
1x Utillian 6 Mouthpiece Vortex Seal
